bruno-directed.source: Qwen3-TTS-1.7B VoiceDesign official hosted demo; see generation-requests.json and raw take metadata
bruno-directed.license: Apache-2.0 model; original fictional performance, no real-person recording or clone
bruno-directed.notes: A young adult male footballer with a bright, slightly raspy voice, SHOUTING furiously across a football pitch to get the referee's attention. Two explosive projected calls, the second louder and more outraged. Strong breath pressure, sharp attack and a stretched vowel. Comic theatrical indignation. This is a full-throated shout, not ordinary speech. Clean dry recording, no crowd.

oliver-directed.source: Qwen3-TTS-1.7B VoiceDesign official hosted demo; see generation-requests.json and raw take metadata
oliver-directed.license: Apache-2.0 model; original fictional performance, no real-person recording or clone
oliver-directed.notes: An adult British English man with a thin, pinched mid-high voice. He is tearfully begging for forgiveness, on the edge of a ridiculous emotional breakdown. His breath catches before the second so, his voice trembles and cracks on sorry into a pleading whimper. Play this as an embarrassed man trying and failing to hold back tears. Urgent and compressed, about two seconds. Clean dry close microphone, no music.

carrick-directed.source: Qwen3-TTS-1.7B VoiceDesign official hosted demo; see generation-requests.json and raw take metadata
carrick-directed.license: Apache-2.0 model; original fictional performance, no real-person recording or clone
carrick-directed.notes: A middle-aged British English man with a low, slightly gravelly voice and a restrained northern English accent. Bone-dry sarcasm, fed up but completely controlled. Deliver this short question as a cutting comeback, stress POINTS, then let with that fall dismissively. Brisk, about one and a half seconds, no introductory breath or extra words. A deadpan comic punchline. Clean dry close microphone, no music.

fishing.notes: Young adult male, youthful light Manchester English accent, slightly nasal forward voice, cheeky and impatient. less-problem.source: New local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign acted take; assets/film-voices-v002; listening review pending
less-problem.notes: Adult male, medium pitch slightly rough forward voice, light Portuguese English accent, expressive urgent football captain. An overconfident captain delighted that an opponent has gone. Exhale relieved ONE LESS, then smug satisfied PROBLEM. A private little victory, not narration.

contract.source: New local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign acted take; assets/film-voices-v002; listening review pending
contract.notes: Deep rich British male baritone with confident theatrical diction, smug experienced professional. A cartoon goalpost who believes he is the star goalkeeper. Booming theatrical TWO SAVES! A beat of smug self admiration, then an imperious brisk demand: I WANT A NEW CONTRACT. Grand and funny, strong consonants.

var.source: Local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign VAR excuse; film-voices-v003; listening review pending
var.notes: Middle-aged British man, dry clipped bureaucratic diction, thin precise voice. An officious British official issuing a ludicrously overconfident verdict. ONSIDE. NO TOUCH. Then dismiss the objection with smug certainty: ENZO was SLEEPING. A short deliberate pause, then an emphatic final GOAL. Dry comic finality, crisp authoritative diction, no soft fading endings.

him.notes: Young adult man, light Argentine English accent, rough mid-low voice with urgent force. Angry captain yelling an urgent objection over a celebrating crowd. WHAT ABOUT HIM?! Abrupt, strongly projected and incredulous; land HIM as an accusation.

yes.source: New local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign acted take; assets/film-voices-v002; listening review pending

ours.source: New local Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign acted take; assets/film-voices-v002; listening review pending
ours.notes: Young adult male, light Belgian English accent, clear warm medium voice. A goalkeeper gasping in startled relief after a near miss. OURS WORKS TOO! Sudden delighted discovery, incredulous upward lilt and a smile, projected to his teammates.
